schemes.orig: original: resample papers, take the distinct targets (np.unique) -> biased
schemes.A_target: resample distinct targets with replacement, multinomial weights, negatives fixed
schemes.B_paper_weighted: resample papers; weight(t) = resampled incidences / observed incidences (E = 1)
schemes.delong: DeLong analytic SE; se_pos = positives only (candidates are an enumerated population), se_full = + negative component; 95 % CI = estimate +- 1.96 se_full
